family: Every Boolean truth table in dimensions 1,2,3, every nonempty anchor J, every physical query including anchor coordinates; alpha=1/6
domain: n=1..3; all truth tables; all nonempty masks; all coordinates; no symmetry reduction
pilot: n<=2, exactly 100 local queries, no dimension escalation
arithmetic: Integer literal Walsh sums, exact Fraction channels/banks, prime-exponent log words for equalities, outward dyadic rational log2 intervals with proved atanh tail for inequalities
adaptive_histories: Second implementation: all n<=3 truth tables, all nonempty anchors, deterministic anchor-first and anchor-last complete trees, plus stop-after-first-query; exact coefficient mass supermartingale, full terminal laws.
